title: Validation rehearsal
text: Rehearsal applies item-declared migrations only to the separately bound validation database and records durable control-plane receipts. Before the first apply, it retains one private archive of that exact validation database and commits and verifies each module's migration_audit.backup_path; a missing archive or receipt refuses mutation, and the restore point remains bound through apply, invariants and verification commands. Attested commands run after each module with its exact identifier in reserved YOKE_MIGRATION_REHEARSAL_MODULE, replacing inherited context; module-specific commands validate it before using the copy, while fleet callbacks run after complete convergence. A selected source worker must be an active registered lane of the named item, authorized by the caller's matching item or task claim. Invalid source bindings refuse with rehearsal_source_lane_invalid and recovery; without a binding the ordinary item-lane default wins over cwd.
